caption: A clear, faceted glass tumbler stands centered against a smooth gray gradient, packed with several irregular ice cubes that protrude above the rim. The glass and its mirror-like reflection on the glossy surface remain fixed in the frame. The pile of ice keeps the same arrangement, with a tilted cube near the center, cubes crowding the left and right sides, and a rounded cube resting on top. Only very subtle surface changes occur as small bright spots and short drip-like marks appear and fade near the edges of the tumbler. These faint highlights vary slowly without moving the ice or altering the overall shape of the glass. The background shows a gentle variation in brightness, while the glass itself stays stationary and upright. The scene remains nearly still, dominated by quiet reflections and tiny changes on the transparent surfaces.
relations: Glass tumbler and ice pile remain fixed, preserving their arrangement and mirror-like reflection on the glossy surface.
Faint bright spots and short drip marks appear and fade slowly on the glass edges without moving the ice.
Background brightness varies gently, while the stationary glass shows only quiet reflections and tiny surface changes.
